integrity.euler_basis: Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; a singularity-free proof using Rosenlicht stratification is included.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A base-B diagonal one-parameter subgroup has one projective fixed point for each degree-d monomial, and every such monomial factors with every prescribed partition of d.
integrity.object_basis: The cited archival source defines the projective variety of degree-d forms admitting a factorization with degrees prescribed by a partition lambda.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: arXiv:1502.00167 is Algebraic Geometry and lists primary MSC 14N15.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns the closed projective locus of forms admitting a prescribed factorization, not the locally closed exact irreducible-factorization stratum.
Equality of Euler characteristics does not imply equality of finer topological invariants.
The proof is elementary after combining the classical reducible-form parameter space with torus localization, so an unindexed prior observation may exist.
title: Factorization type is invisible to Euler characteristic for reducible-form varieties
